uncached_tokens.requirement: compile uncached tokens <= prefix uncached tokens (factor 1.0x)

notes: Fixture is REAL repository content: https://github.com/encode/httpx @ b5addb64f0161ff6bfe94c124ef76f6a1fba5254; the raw bundle is the 4-file slice (7902 tiktoken) rendered with FILE headers (actual bytes, stable order); per-file sha256 in the fixture so a fresh clone can audit the exact bytes.

The compile arm's fabric is built MECHANICALLY by evals/mech_fabric.build_blocks from the same source files (signatures, docstrings, assignments, imports, cartridge); it never reads any objective or answer key. Role divergence comes only from the fixed file-ownership map (each role owns one file).

Three arms over a 12-objective, 4-role (planner/implementer/tester/reviewer) workload; broadcast sends the full bundle to every agent, prefix appends a per-role instruction after the shared bundle (vLLM prefix caching's best case), compile sends each role's compiled packet via the LangGraph adapter.

Each arm's system content is prefixed with a unique arm tag so the persistent vLLM prefix cache cannot carry between arms; within an arm the shared bytes (broadcast: whole system; prefix: bundle; compile: none) drive prefix reuse.

Quality is the same deterministic required+forbidden scorer for every arm (all required facts present, no forbidden fact present); every objective, repeat and response is reported, pass or fail. Forbidden facts are plausible wrong answers from the source; whether a compiled packet carries one is an outcome, not a precondition.
The compile arm compiles client-side (compile_node_packet), not through a sidecar; its 'compiled' flag is self-computed, not a server header.

Prefix-cache counters come from the upstream Prometheus /metrics (vLLM), parsed tolerantly (null when unavailable); uncached tokens = billed prompt tokens minus the prefix-cache hit-token delta. The first request of each arm is a cold prefill.
n=12 objectives x 3 repeats per arm, temperature=0.0, non-streaming, max_tokens=48; single GPU, single 1.5B model.
